Why this why now
This unit is a natural extension of the number work in the previous units. We are now seeking to generalise patterns and behaviours that were first seen in the number units taught before, and pulling in key skills such as factorisation and multiplication of brackets as part of algebraic manipulation.

Algebra
Why this why now
This unit builds on solving linear equations from year 7 where pupils learnt to rearrange aan equation to find a specific value that satisfied the equation. In expressions and formulae, pupils use their understanding of rearrangement to change the subject of a formula. Pupils are then introduced binomial equations in preparation for trigonometry.
